entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Quintus Titurius Sabinus was one of Caesar's legates during the Gallic Wars. He is first mentioned in Caesar's campaign against the Remi, in 57 BC. In 56 BC, he was sent by Caesar with three legions against the Venelli, Curiosolitae, and Lexovii, who were led by Viridovix. He gained a great victory over Viridovix's forces, and all the insurgent states submitted to his authority.
